how_verified: The whole dataset was run against the official oracle, i.e. the dataset's
cb run dataset cua-bench-basic@1.0 --oracle --on local --runtime runc \
and the same dataset was then run with the model. A task is listed here
only when the oracle scores 0 on EVERY variant AND the model scored 1 on
NO variant, and the failure has a mechanism that is understood.
That conjunction is the point. date-picker is the counterexample: its
oracle scores 0 on all five variants (it types into input[type=date], which
WebKitGTK ignores), yet the model solved v4 by clicking the picker's spin
buttons — so the task is reachable and the oracle, not the environment, is
what fails. A single-variant reading of 'oracle == 0' would have called
date-picker an environment limit and inflated the score.
score.py enforces the same conjunction at report time and refuses a

oracle_baseline.note: of these, the model solved date-picker v4, spreadsheet-cell v4 and video-player v2, which is how their tasks were shown reachable

drag-drop.reason: HTML5 drag-and-drop needs synthetic drag input, and WebKitGTK rejects it under runc without /dev/uinput.
drag-drop.mechanism_evidence: Page-side event listeners in a real bench-web container confirm mousedown, mousemove and mouseup all arrive at the page while dragstart never fires — even with 30 dense interpolated steps. cua-spacesd's own diagnostic string says 'WebKitGTK rejects synthetic XSendEvent input'; its real path needs /dev/uinput, absent here.
drag-drop.no_alternate_route: The drop target only reacts to a drop event, so click/keyboard workarounds are not available. (drag-slider is the contrast: also a drag, but reachable by click-then-arrow-keys, and it scores 1 on all five variants.)

notes: date-picker and fill-form are deliberately NOT listed. The model scored 1
on date-picker v4 and fill-form v0/v1, so those tasks are reachable here.
fill-form's oracle also passes all three variants.
A variant the model solved is never excluded, whatever its oracle did:
exclusion exists to stop a broken environment reading as model weakness,
and a solved variant is proof the environment worked.
